provenance.token_usage_statement: Historical SA provider prompt/completion/total tokens were not recorded; all are null. No actual-token-match claim is supported.
provenance.matching: 80 case UIDs recomputed from frozen identity payloads; exact ordered source nodes, injection fields, original file bytes SHA256 and SA record SHA256; native metrics match unified scoring.
provenance.graph_reconstruction: This check verifies the frozen identity payload and original source record. Runner preflight separately rebuilds graphs and rechecks injected input identity.
provenance.selected_result_policy: Exact projection of original native ranking, scores and evidence_risk_subgraph_nodes. Full original record remains at source_file and is fixed by source_sha256 and source_sa_record_sha256.
